sources.notes: Extracted without pixel changes from the official basemap_data==2.0.0 PyPI wheel. Used as the photographic Earth base texture; combined with Natural Earth physical relief and color grading. The package-wide LGPL metadata refers to GSHHG layers, which are not used here.

sources.author: Natural Earth; Tom Patterson / Nathaniel Vaughn Kelso and contributors
sources.notes: Natural Earth I raster with shaded relief and water, scale 1:50m, 10800x5400. Equirectangular EPSG:4326 extent [-180,-90,180,90]. Converted from original GeoTIFF to JPEG quality95 without chroma subsampling. This is a physical/cartographic raster based on land cover and relief, not a newly captured satellite photograph.
